note: Detection thresholds for the AI content detector. Two-FPR zone model: scores at or above tauFpr1 map to the confident zone, tauFpr5 to the likely zone (and symmetrically on the human side); the band between the zones is an abstention area. Calibration values (scoreMidpoint/scoreScale) are the sigmoid mapping from the Binoculars-style score to a probability and MUST be re-fit on a domain calibration corpus before trusting the numbers (see docs, v1.5).
